   echo "Checking System Zone integrity (sha256)..."
   [[ -f "$CHECKSUMS_FILE" ]] || { warn "No checksums file - skipping integrity check"; return; }

+    [[ -z "$file" || -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue

-      local actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+      actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)

     2	# Loa Framework: CI/CD Validation (Enterprise Grade)

     4	# Exit codes: 0 = success, 1 = failure

    28	if [[ "${CI:-}" == "true" ]] || [[ ! -t 1 ]]; then
    29	  RED=''; GREEN=''; YELLOW=''; NC=''
    30	else
    31	  RED='\033[0;31m'; GREEN='\033[0;32m'; YELLOW='\033[1;33m'; NC='\033[0m'
    32	fi
    33	
    34	log() { echo -e "${GREEN}[loa-check]${NC} $*"; }
    35	warn() { echo -e "${YELLOW}[loa-check]${NC} $*"; }
    36	fail() { echo -e "${RED}[loa-check]${NC} x $*"; FAILURES=$((FAILURES + 1)); }

    38	FAILURES=0

    41	  echo "Checking Loa installation..."

    48	#   present, hash matches            -> ok
    49	#   present, hash differs            -> Tampered (fail)
    50	#   absent, submodule mount detected (.loa/.claude is a directory) and the
    51	#     path exists under .loa/<path>   -> not-mounted (counted, one summary
    52	#     line, informational: never changes the exit code; the mount links a
    53	#     subset of the upstream tree by design)
    54	#   absent otherwise                 -> Missing (fail)
    55	# The manifest is read once (path<TAB>hash) instead of one jq call per path.
    56	check_integrity() {
    57	  echo "Checking System Zone integrity (sha256)..."
    58	  [[ -f "$CHECKSUMS_FILE" ]] || { warn "No checksums file - skipping integrity check"; return; }
    59	
    60	  local drift=false

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace
    35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
    36	#   --trial N           trial number
    37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
    38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
    39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
    40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
    41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
    44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
    45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
    46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
    47	#
    48	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
    49	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
    50	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
    51	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
    52	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
    53	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
    54	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
    55	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
    56	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
    57	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
    58	#
    59	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
    60	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
    61	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
    62	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
    63	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
    64	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
    65	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
    66	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
    67	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    68	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
    69	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
    70	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
    71	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    72	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
    73	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
    74	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
    75	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
    76	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
    77	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
    78	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
    79	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
    80	# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
    81	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
    82	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
    83	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
    84	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
    85	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
    86	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
    87	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
    88	#
    89	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
    90	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
    91	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
    92	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
    93	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
    94	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
    95	#
    96	# Exit codes:
    97	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
    98	#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
    99	#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
   100	#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
   101	#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
   102	#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
   103	#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
   104	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
   105	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
   106	# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
   107	#
   108	# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
   109	# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
   110	# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR.
   111	#

# Dockerfile.ablation — container executor image for the cycle-130 component ablation
# (SDD D-4.9 / DEC-0411). Extends Dockerfile.sandbox's pinned base and non-root user
# with the Claude Code CLI, the codex CLI, pytest and bats. It holds NO credentials.
# pipeline-run.sh mounts exactly two host paths: the sandbox read-write at /workspace
# and a per-run writable HOME at /home/evaluser (<run>/meta/home: the codex CLI's
# auth.json/config.toml copies, empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store). The
# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
#
# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
# Run:
#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
#
# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'
FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br

FROM node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:8ea90c4f037cc3c2f566eb46c53eaac005129113487eda4090058fe554578104 AS base

ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.299
ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1
ARG PYTEST_VERSION=9.0.2
ARG BATS_VERSION=v1.13.0

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    bash \
    git \
    jq \
    python3 \
    python3-pip \
    python3-venv \
    grep \
    diffutils \
    coreutils \
    procps \
    ca-certificates \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# yq (mikefarah/yq) with SHA256 integrity verification (as Dockerfile.sandbox)
ARG YQ_VERSION=v4.40.5
ARG YQ_SHA256_AMD64=0d6aaf1cf44a8d18fbc7ed0ef14f735a8df8d2e314c4cc0f0242d35c0a440c95
ARG YQ_SHA256_ARM64=9431f0fa39a0af03a152d7fe19a86e42e9ff28d503ed4a70598f9261ec944a97
RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
    case "$arch" in \
      amd64) yq_arch="amd64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; \
      arm64) yq_arch="arm64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; \
      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" && exit 1 ;; \
    esac && \
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${yq_arch}" \
      -o /usr/local/bin/yq && \
    echo "${yq_sha256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c - && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq

# The two CLIs at the versions the fingerprint pins (exact versions, no ranges).
RUN npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit \
      "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}" \
      "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}" \
    && npm cache clean --force

# pytest for Python fixtures (bookworm's pip is externally managed)
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "pytest==${PYTEST_VERSION}"
# cheval's declared dependencies (.claude/adapters/pyproject.toml: dependencies + the `full` extra),
# so the sandbox gates (adversarial-review.sh, flatline-orchestrator.sh) can dispatch (lead, DEC-0482)
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "rfc8785>=0.1.4" "jsonschema>=4.21" "pyyaml>=6.0" "httpx[http2]>=0.24.0"

# bats-core at the pinned tag
RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BATS_VERSION}" https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core.git /tmp/bats-core && \
    /tmp/bats-core/install.sh /usr/local && \
    rm -rf /tmp/bats-core

# Disable npm lifecycle scripts for anything the agent installs later
RUN npm config set ignore-scripts true

# Non-root user (as Dockerfile.sandbox). At run time /home/evaluser is replaced by the
# per-run HOME bind mount and the process runs as the host uid (--user).
RUN groupadd -r evaluser && useradd -r -g evaluser -d /home/evaluser -s /bin/bash evaluser
# No beads (br) in the image: beads_rust 0.2.6 is not on crates.io and the host binary needs glibc 2.38+; the sandbox
# materialiser writes the beads opt-out marker (LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN unset/absent), so every arm runs the skills'
# markdown fallback alike (lead, Sprint 258).
RUN mkdir -p /home/evaluser/.aws /home/evaluser/.claude /home/evaluser/.codex /workspace && \
    chown -R evaluser:evaluser /home/evaluser /workspace

ENV TZ=UTC
ENV LC_ALL=C
ENV HOME=/home/evaluser
ENV NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
ENV CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1

USER evaluser
WORKDIR /workspace

# Health check — every tool the fingerprint names is present
RUN bash --version && git --version && jq --version && node --version && \
    python3 --version && python3 -m pytest --version && yq --version && \
    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
    echo "All tools verified"

ENTRYPOINT []
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

94	_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }

96	# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
97	# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
98	# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
99	# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
100	# hashes the corpus the same way.
101	_sm_sha256() {
102	  python3 -I -c '
103	import hashlib, sys
104	for p in sys.argv[1:]:
105	    h = hashlib.sha256()
106	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
107	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
108	            h.update(b)
109	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
110	}

112	# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
113	_sm_evidence() {
114	  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
115	  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
116	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
117	  else
118	    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
119	    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
120	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
121	  fi
122	}

162	  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
163	  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
164	  local found=0 entry=""
165	  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then

167	    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
168	      || entry=""
169	    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
170	  fi
171	  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
172	    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
173	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
174	    return 2

176	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
177	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
178	    return 2
179	  fi

181	  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
182	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }

188	# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
189	_sm_drop_md_section() {
190	  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
191	  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
192	  awk -v h="$heading" '
193	    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
194	    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
195	    skip { n++; next }
196	    { print }
197	    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
198	  mv "$tmp" "$f"
199	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"

202	# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
203	# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
204	# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
205	_sm_drop_paragraph() {
206	  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
207	import re, sys
208	path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
209	text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
210	paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
211	for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
212	    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
213	        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
214	            removed = paras[i]
215	            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
216	            del paras[i:i + 2]
217	            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
218	            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
219	            sys.exit(0)
220	sys.exit(1)
221	PY

226	_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
227	  local f="$1" tmp
228	  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
229	  awk '
230	    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
231	    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
232	    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
233	    { print }
234	    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
235	  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
236	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
237	}

239	# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.
240	_sm_frontmatter_has_effort() {
241	  awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && $0 == "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && /^effort:/ { found = 1; exit 0 } END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }' "$1"
242	}

247	  local p

250	    [[ "$(P="$p" yq -r 'eval(strenv(P))' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" == "false" ]] || return 1
251	  done
252	  return 0

293	        ;;
294	      rule_files)
295	        local r gone=""
296	        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do

303	        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
304	        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }

315	        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"

322	          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
323	          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi

326	        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"

328	          local nkeys
329	          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"

376	regen_sandbox_manifest() {
377	  local ws="$1"
378	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
379	  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then

381	    return 0
382	  fi
383	  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
384	  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
385	     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
386	    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
387	    how="gen-checksums.sh"
388	  else
389	    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
390	    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
391	    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
392	      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
393	    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
394	    : > "$sums"
395	    local -a batch=()
396	    local f
397	    while IFS= read -r f; do
398	      batch+=("$f")
399	      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
400	        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
401	        batch=()
402	      fi
403	    done < "$list"
404	    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
405	      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
406	    fi
407	    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
408	      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
409	       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
410	      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
411	    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
412	    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
413	  fi
414	  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
415	  local digest
416	  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
417	  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
418	  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
419	  return 0

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    60	  esac
    61	done
    62	[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
    63	  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
    64	command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"
    65	
    66	SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    67	yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/gen-checksums.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.1, DEC-0368)
     4	#
     5	# Writes the System Zone integrity manifest `.claude/checksums.json` from the
     6	# TRACKED `.claude/` tree only. The legacy generators (mount-loa.sh and
     7	# update.sh `generate_checksums`) walk the working tree with `find`, so build,
     8	# cache and runtime artefacts (`__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `node_modules`,
     9	# `.run/`) that exist only on the generating machine end up in the manifest and
    10	# read as Missing on every fresh mount. This generator lists
    11	#
    12	#   git -C ROOT ls-files -z -- .claude
    13	#
    14	# minus every path under `.claude/overrides/` (user-owned) and minus the
    15	# manifest itself (`.claude/checksums.json`), hashes each with
    16	# `sha256_portable` (.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh) and writes
    17	#
    18	#   {"generated": "<UTC ISO-8601>", "algorithm": "sha256",
    19	#    "files": {"<path>": "<sha256 hex>", ...}}
    20	#
    21	# pretty-printed by jq (2-space), keys in `LC_ALL=C` byte order. Two runs on
    22	# the same tree are byte-identical except `generated`. The working-tree content
    23	# of each tracked path is hashed (an unstaged edit is reflected); a tracked
    24	# path deleted from the working tree is skipped with a warning on stderr.
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh [--root DIR] [--out FILE]   # (re)generate
    28	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh --check [--root DIR] [--out FILE]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --root DIR   repository work tree to read (default: the git top level of
    32	#                the current directory)
    33	#   --out FILE   manifest path (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json). With
    34	#                --check this is the committed manifest that is compared.
    35	#   --check      regenerate to a temp file and compare its `files` map with
    36	#                the manifest at --out; nothing is written
    37	#   -h, --help   this text
    38	#
    39	# Exit codes:
    40	#   0  generated, or --check: the `files` maps are identical
    41	#   1  --check: drift (the first ten differing paths, each labelled added /
    42	#      removed / changed, on stderr) or the manifest is absent / not JSON
    43	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or a tracked path name that
    44	#      cannot be represented safely (newline, tab or backslash)
    45	# =============================================================================
    46	set -euo pipefail
    47	export LC_ALL=C
    48	
    49	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    50	# shellcheck source=../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh
    51	source "${SELF_DIR}/../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    52	
    53	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    54	die2() { echo "gen-checksums: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    55	
    56	MANIFEST_REL=".claude/checksums.json"
    57	ROOT=""
    58	OUT=""
    59	CHECK=0
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --check) CHECK=1; shift ;;
    63	    --root)
    64	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    65	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --out)
    67	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--out requires a file path"
    68	      OUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    69	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    70	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    71	  esac
    72	done
    73	
    74	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    75	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    76	fi
    77	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
    78	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
    79	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
    80	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    81	[[ -n "$OUT" ]] || OUT="${ROOT}/${MANIFEST_REL}"
    82	
    83	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gen-checksums.XXXXXX")"
    84	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
    85	trap cleanup EXIT
    86	
    87	# --- 1. the tracked set (NUL-safe, C-sorted, overrides and manifest removed) --
    88	files=()
    89	while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
    90	  case "$path" in
    91	    .claude/overrides/*|"$MANIFEST_REL") continue ;;
    92	  esac
    93	  case "$path" in
    94	    *$'\n'*|*$'\t'*|*\\*) die2 "refusing a tracked path with a newline, tab or backslash: $(printf '%q' "$path")" ;;
    95	  esac
    96	  if [[ ! -f "${ROOT}/${path}" ]]; then
    97	    # A gitlink, a dangling symlink or a path deleted in the working tree.
    98	    echo "gen-checksums: warning: tracked path not a file in the working tree, skipped: $path" >&2
    99	    continue
   100	  fi
   101	  files+=("$path")
   102	done < <(git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -z -- .claude | sort -z)
   103	
   104	# --- 2. hash in chunks (one sha256 process per 400 paths, order preserved) ----
   105	TSV="${TMP_DIR}/files.tsv"
   106	: > "$TSV"
   107	n=${#files[@]}
   108	i=0
   109	while [[ $i -lt $n ]]; do
   110	  chunk=("${files[@]:i:400}")
   111	  hashes=()
   112	  while IFS= read -r line; do
   113	    hashes+=("${line%% *}")
   114	  done < <(cd "$ROOT" && sha256_portable "${chunk[@]}")
   115	  [[ ${#hashes[@]} -eq ${#chunk[@]} ]] || die2 "sha256 returned ${#hashes[@]} digests for ${#chunk[@]} paths"
   116	  j=0
   117	  while [[ $j -lt ${#chunk[@]} ]]; do
   118	    [[ "${hashes[j]}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die2 "unexpected sha256 output for ${chunk[j]}"
   119	    printf '%s\t%s\n' "${chunk[j]}" "${hashes[j]}" >> "$TSV"
   120	    j=$((j + 1))
   121	  done
   122	  i=$((i + 400))
   123	done
   124	[[ $n -gt 0 ]] || echo "gen-checksums: warning: no tracked files under .claude in $ROOT" >&2
   125	
   126	GEN="${TMP_DIR}/checksums.json"
   127	jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
   128	  {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
   129	   files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | split("\t") | {key: .[0], value: .[1]}] | from_entries)}
   130	' < "$TSV" > "$GEN"
   131	
   132	# --- 3a. write ----------------------------------------------------------------
   133	if [[ $CHECK -eq 0 ]]; then
   134	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
   135	  chmod 0644 "$GEN"
   136	  # mv replaces a symlinked manifest instead of writing through it.
   137	  mv -f "$GEN" "$OUT"
   138	  echo "gen-checksums: wrote $n entries to $OUT" >&2
   139	  exit 0
   140	fi
   141	
   142	# --- 3b. --check --------------------------------------------------------------
   143	if [[ ! -f "$OUT" ]]; then
   144	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: manifest not found: $OUT (run tools/gen-checksums.sh)" >&2
   145	  exit 1
   146	fi
   147	if ! jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$OUT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   148	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: manifest is not JSON with a files object: $OUT" >&2
   149	  exit 1
   150	fi
   151	DIFF="${TMP_DIR}/diff.txt"
   152	jq -rn --slurpfile old "$OUT" --slurpfile new "$GEN" '
   153	  ($old[0].files) as $o | ($new[0].files) as $n |
   154	  ( [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select($o | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "added"} ]
   155	  + [ $o | keys[] | . as $p | select($n | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "removed"} ]
   156	  + [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select(($o | has($p)) and $o[$p] != $n[$p]) | {p: $p, k: "changed"} ] )
   157	  | sort_by(.p) | .[] | "\(.k): \(.p)"
   158	' > "$DIFF"
   159	count=$(wc -l < "$DIFF" | tr -d ' ')
   160	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
   161	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: OK ($n entries match $OUT)" >&2
   162	  exit 0
   163	fi
   164	echo "gen-checksums: --check: DRIFT — $count path(s) differ between $OUT and the tracked tree:" >&2
   165	sed -n '1,10s/^/  /p' "$DIFF" >&2
   166	[[ "$count" -le 10 ]] || echo "  ... and $((count - 10)) more" >&2
   167	echo "gen-checksums: regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   168	exit 1

12:# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
13:#
14:#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
15:#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
16:#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
17:#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
18:#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
19:#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
20:#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
21:#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
22:#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
23:#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
24:#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
25:#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
26:#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
27:#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
28:#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
29:#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
30:#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
31:#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
32:#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
33:#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
34:#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
35:#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
36:#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
37:#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
38:#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
39:#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
40:#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
41:#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
42:#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
43:#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
44:#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
45:#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
46:#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
47:#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
48:#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
49:#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
50:#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
51:#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
52:#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
53:#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
54:#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
55:#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
56:#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
57:#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
58:#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
59:#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
60:#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
61:#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
62:#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
63:#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
64:#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
65:#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
66:#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
67:#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
68:#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
69:#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
70:#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
71:#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
72:#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
73:#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
74:#
75:# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
76:# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
77:# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
78:#
79:# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
80:# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
81:# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
82:# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
83:#
84:# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
85:# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
86:# =============================================================================

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/check-manifest-paths.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.2, DEC-0368)
     4	#
     5	# CI gate for the System Zone integrity manifest: every path listed in
     6	# `.claude/checksums.json` must be TRACKED (`git ls-files -- .claude`) and
     7	# PRESENT in the working tree. A manifest generated by walking a dirty tree
     8	# (the #1267 class) lists build, cache and runtime artefacts that no fresh
     9	# mount has, so every downstream `check-loa.sh` reports them as Missing.
    10	#
    11	# Offenders are grouped on stderr:
    12	#   untracked  — listed in the manifest, not in `git ls-files`; each carries a
    13	#                DIAGNOSTIC class (first match wins):
    14	#                  __pycache__ | .pytest_cache | node_modules | .run
    15	#                      (a path component of that name)
    16	#                  .pyc   (name ends in .pyc)
    17	#                  .lock  (name ends in .lock)
    18	#                  other
    19	#   missing    — tracked, but absent from the working tree
    20	# The classes label untracked offenders only: a TRACKED path is never flagged
    21	# for its name (a committed `.lock` fixture is legitimate).
    22	#
    23	# Last line on stdout:
    24	#   manifest-paths: N entries, M untracked (class=count, ...), K missing
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/check-manifest-paths.sh [--manifest FILE] [--root DIR]
    28	#
    29	# Options:
    30	#   --root DIR       repository work tree (default: the git top level of the
    31	#                    current directory)
    32	#   --manifest FILE  manifest to check (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json)
    33	#   -h, --help       this text
    34	#
    35	# Exit codes:
    36	#   0  every manifest path is tracked and present
    37	#   1  at least one untracked or missing path (listed on stderr)
    38	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or the manifest is absent or
    39	#      not JSON with a `files` object
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die2() { echo "check-manifest-paths: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    46	
    47	ROOT=""
    48	MANIFEST=""
    49	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    50	  case "$1" in
    51	    --root)
    52	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    53	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    54	    --manifest)
    55	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--manifest requires a file path"
    56	      MANIFEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    58	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    59	  esac
    60	done
    61	
    62	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    63	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    64	fi
    65	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
    66	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
    67	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
    68	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    69	[[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]] || MANIFEST="${ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json"
    70	[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || die2 "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
    71	jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    72	  || die2 "manifest is not JSON with a files object: $MANIFEST"
    73	
    74	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/check-manifest-paths.XXXXXX")"
    75	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
    76	trap cleanup EXIT
    77	
    78	# Both lists newline-separated and C-sorted. A path with a newline cannot be
    79	# represented in either list; gen-checksums.sh refuses to emit one.
    80	git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -- .claude | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/tracked"
    81	jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/listed"
    82	comm -23 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
    83	comm -12 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/both"
    84	
    85	classify() {
    86	  local p="$1"
    87	  if [[ "$p" =~ (^|/)(__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|\.run)(/|$) ]]; then
    88	    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    89	  elif [[ "$p" == *.pyc ]]; then
    90	    printf '.pyc'
    91	  elif [[ "$p" == *.lock ]]; then
    92	    printf '.lock'
    93	  else
    94	    printf 'other'
    95	  fi
    96	}
    97	
    98	# Classified untracked offenders: "<class>\t<path>"
    99	: > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   100	while IFS= read -r p; do
   101	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   102	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(classify "$p")" "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   103	done < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
   104	
   105	: > "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   106	while IFS= read -r p; do
   107	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   108	  [[ -e "${ROOT}/${p}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   109	done < "${TMP_DIR}/both"
   110	
   111	entries=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/listed" | tr -d ' ')
   112	n_untracked=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | tr -d ' ')
   113	n_missing=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/missing" | tr -d ' ')
   114	
   115	class_summary=""
   116	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 ]]; then
   117	  echo "check-manifest-paths: untracked manifest paths (not in git ls-files -- .claude), by class:" >&2
   118	  for cls in __pycache__ .pytest_cache node_modules .run .pyc .lock other; do
   119	    c=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   120	    [[ "$c" -gt 0 ]] || continue
   121	    class_summary="${class_summary:+${class_summary}, }${cls}=${c}"
   122	    echo "  [${cls}] ${c} path(s):" >&2
   123	    awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c { print "    " $2 }' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" >&2
   124	  done
   125	fi
   126	if [[ "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   127	  echo "check-manifest-paths: tracked manifest paths absent from the working tree:" >&2
   128	  sed 's/^/    /' "${TMP_DIR}/missing" >&2
   129	fi
   130	
   131	echo "manifest-paths: ${entries} entries, ${n_untracked} untracked${class_summary:+ (${class_summary})}, ${n_missing} missing"
   132	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 || "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   133	  echo "check-manifest-paths: FAIL — regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   134	  exit 1
   135	fi
   136	exit 0

set_state() { STATE="$1"; write_status; }

# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
  # audit r1 DISS-C-005: classify on the CLI's stderr only, never on the agent's own
  # output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry by mentioning a network
  # error; the patterns are the CLI's transport messages, not free text.
  grep -qiE 'rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]' \
    "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
  return 1
}

run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"

    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
  fi

    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
    ex_rc=0
    # audit r1 DISS-C-001: the arm's toggles come from the suite declaration only; a
    # LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES inherited from the parent environment never reaches a trial
    env -u LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES \
      EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
      local gout gexit=0
      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then
        graders="$(jq -c '.graders' <<<"$gout")"; composite="$(jq -c '.composite' <<<"$gout")"
      fi
      if [[ $gexit -le 1 ]]; then status="completed"; err_json='null'
      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
      break
    fi

keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do
    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/$f" "$dest/$f"
  done
  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"
  return 0
}

# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
    set_state failed; exit 3
  fi
  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
    local cost
    cost="$(jq -r '(.executor.total_cost_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
    [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
      ARM_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${ARM_SUM[$i]}" "$cost")"; ARM_N[$i]=$(( ${ARM_N[$i]} + 1 ))
      POOL_SUM="$(fadd "$POOL_SUM" "$cost")"; POOL_N=$((POOL_N + 1))
    fi
    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
    else
      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
    fi
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
  else
    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
  fi
  write_status
}

log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
write_status

PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
  local i
  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"

        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
        break
      fi
    done
    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
  done
  return 0
}

}
# budget_gate <arm> <trial-number> — 0 launch; 1 cut (CUT_JSON set). Waits for a

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
     4	#
     5	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
     6	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
     7	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
     8	#
     9	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
    10	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
    11	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
    12	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
    13	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
    14	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
    15	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
    16	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
    17	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
    18	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
    19	#                    submodule from there; no network).
    20	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
    21	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
    22	#      is printed, then a summary line
    23	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
    24	#
    25	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
    26	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
    27	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
    28	#
    29	# Usage:
    30	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
    31	#
    32	# Options:
    33	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
    34	#                repository the script lives in)
    35	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
    36	#                (use before the change is committed)
    37	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
    38	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
    39	#                /tmp)
    40	#   -h, --help   this text
    41	#
    42	# Exit codes:
    43	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
    44	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
    45	#   2    usage error
    46	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
    47	#        the failing step's output is printed
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    53	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
    55	
    56	REF=""
    57	KEEP=0
    58	WORKTREE=0
    59	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --ref)
    63	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
    64	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    65	    --tmp)
    66	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
    67	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    68	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
    69	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
    70	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    71	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    72	  esac
    73	done
    74	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
    75	
    76	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
    77	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
    78	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
    79	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
    82	cleanup() {
    83	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
    84	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
    85	  else
    86	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    87	  fi
    88	}
    89	trap cleanup EXIT
    90	
    91	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
    92	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
    93	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
    94	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
    95	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
    96	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
    97	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
    98	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
    99	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   100	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   101	
   102	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   103	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   104	  local desc="$1"; shift
   105	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   106	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   107	    die3 "$desc"
   108	  fi
   109	}
   110	
   111	suffix=""
   112	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   113	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   114	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   115	
   116	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   117	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   118	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   119	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   120	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   121	
   122	overlay() {
   123	  local p
   124	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   125	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   126	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   127	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   128	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   129	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   130	    else
   131	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   132	    fi
   133	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   134	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   135	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   136	}
   137	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   138	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   139	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   140	
   141	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   142	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   143	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   144	init_downstream() {
   145	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   146	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   147	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   148	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   149	}
   150	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   151	
   152	do_mount() {
   153	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   154	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   155	}
   156	run_step "mount-submodule.sh" do_mount
   157	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   158	
   159	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------
   160	CFG="$DOWN/.loa.config.yaml"
   161	[[ -f "$CFG" ]] || : > "$CFG"
   162	if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   163	  run_step "aleph.enabled: false" yq -i '.aleph.enabled = false' "$CFG"
   164	else
   165	  printf '\naleph:\n  enabled: false\n' >> "$CFG"
   166	fi
   167	
   168	# --- 4. check-loa.sh ------------------------------------------------------------
   169	OUT="$WORK/check-loa.out"
   170	rc=0
   171	(cd "$DOWN" && CI=true bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh < /dev/null) > "$OUT" 2>&1 || rc=$?
   172	echo "----- check-loa.sh (downstream) -----"
   173	cat "$OUT"
   174	echo "----- end check-loa.sh (exit $rc) -----"
   175	
   176	tampered=$(grep -c 'Tampered: ' "$OUT" || true)
   177	missing=$(grep -c 'Missing: ' "$OUT" || true)
   178	not_mounted=$(sed -n 's/.*not-mounted: \([0-9][0-9]*\) path(s).*/\1/p' "$OUT")
   179	echo "fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=${tampered} Missing=${missing} not-mounted=${not_mounted:-0} check-loa-rc=${rc}"
   180	[[ $rc -eq 0 ]] && exit 0
   181	exit 1

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/check-loa-mount-scope.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1 #1267,
     5	# AC-1.2/AC-1.3; SDD §5.3). check-loa.sh check_integrity classifies every
     6	# manifest path as ok, Tampered (fail), not-mounted (a submodule mount does
     7	# not link it but .loa/<path> has it: counted, one summary line, never a
     8	# failure) or Missing (fail).
     9	#
    10	# Seam: check-loa.sh already guards `main` behind
    11	#   [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]
    12	# so each case sources the script in a child bash inside the fixture
    13	# directory and calls check_integrity alone; the child exits 1 when the
    14	# FAILURES counter is non-zero, the same rule main applies. No other check
    15	# runs, and the script is not modified for the test.
    16	# =============================================================================
    17	
    18	setup() {
    19	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    20	  CHECK="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh"
    21	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cloams.XXXXXX")"
    22	  D="$T/downstream"
    23	  # upstream tree inside the submodule path
    24	  mkdir -p "$D/.loa/.claude/lib" "$D/.claude"
    25	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/a.sh"
    26	  printf 'echo b\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/b.sh"
    27	  printf 'echo c\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh"
    28	  # the mount links a.sh only (b.sh and lib/c.sh are not linked)
    29	  ln -s ../.loa/.claude/a.sh "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    30	  printf 'aleph:\n  enabled: false\n' > "$D/.loa.config.yaml"
    31	  source "$ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    32	  HA="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/a.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    33	  HB="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/b.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    34	  HC="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    35	  write_manifest
    36	}
    37	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    38	
    39	# write_manifest [extra-path hash]... — a/b/lib/c plus any extra pairs
    40	write_manifest() {
    41	  local args=(--arg a "$HA" --arg b "$HB" --arg c "$HC")
    42	  local filter='{".claude/a.sh": $a, ".claude/b.sh": $b, ".claude/lib/c.sh": $c}'
    43	  if [[ $# -ge 2 ]]; then
    44	    args+=(--arg xp "$1" --arg xh "$2")
    45	    filter="$filter + {(\$xp): \$xh}"
    46	  fi
    47	  jq -n "${args[@]}" "{generated: \"2026-10-15T00:00:00Z\", algorithm: \"sha256\", files: ($filter)}" \
    48	    > "$D/.claude/checksums.json"
    49	}
    50	
    51	run_integrity() {
    52	  run bash -c 'cd "$1" && source "$2" && check_integrity && echo "FAILURES=$FAILURES" && [[ $FAILURES -eq 0 ]]' \
    53	    _ "$D" "$CHECK"
    54	}
    55	
    56	@test "CM-1 paths in the upstream tree but not linked are not-mounted; exit unaffected" {
    57	  run_integrity
    58	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    59	  [[ "$output" == *"not-mounted: 2 path(s) exist in the upstream tree but are not linked by this mount"* ]]
    60	  [[ "$output" == *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    61	  [[ "$output" != *"Missing:"* ]]
    62	  [[ "$output" != *"Tampered:"* ]]
    63	  [ "$(grep -c 'not-mounted:' <<< "$output")" -eq 1 ]
    64	}
    65	
    66	@test "CM-2 a present file whose hash differs is Tampered and fails" {
    67	  rm -f "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    68	  printf 'echo tampered\n' > "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    69	  run_integrity
    70	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    71	  [[ "$output" == *"Tampered: .claude/a.sh"* ]]
    72	  [[ "$output" != *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    73	  [[ "$output" == *"FAILURES=1"* ]]
    74	}
    75	
    76	@test "CM-3 a path absent locally and upstream is Missing and fails" {
    77	  write_manifest .claude/gone.sh "$HA"
    78	  run_integrity
    79	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    80	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/gone.sh"* ]]
    81	  [[ "$output" == *"not-mounted: 2 path(s)"* ]]
    82	  [[ "$output" != *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    83	}
    84	
    85	@test "CM-4 without a .loa/ submodule an absent path is Missing" {
    86	  find "$D/.loa" -mindepth 1 -delete
    87	  rmdir "$D/.loa"
    88	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$D/.claude/a.sh.real"
    89	  rm -f "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    90	  mv "$D/.claude/a.sh.real" "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    91	  run_integrity
    92	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    93	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/b.sh"* ]]
    94	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/lib/c.sh"* ]]
    95	  [[ "$output" != *"not-mounted"* ]]
    96	}
    97	
    98	@test "CM-5 every path linked and matching: Integrity verified, no not-mounted line" {
    99	  ln -s ../.loa/.claude/b.sh "$D/.claude/b.sh"
   100	  mkdir -p "$D/.claude/lib"
   101	  ln -s ../../.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh "$D/.claude/lib/c.sh"
   102	  run_integrity
   103	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   104	  [[ "$output" == *"Integrity verified"* ]]
   105	  [[ "$output" != *"not-mounted"* ]]
   106	}
   107	
   108	@test "CM-6 no checksums file: warn and skip, no failure" {
   109	  rm -f "$D/.claude/checksums.json"
   110	  run_integrity
   111	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   112	  [[ "$output" == *"No checksums file - skipping integrity check"* ]]
   113	}

    10	#                      running at its start to <dir>.log

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    26	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    27	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    28	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    29	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    30	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    31	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    32	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    33	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    34	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    35	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    36	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    37	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    38	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    39	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    40	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    41	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    42	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    43	#
    44	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    45	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    46	# =============================================================================
    47	set -euo pipefail
    48	export LC_ALL=C
    49	
    50	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    51	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    52	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    53	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    54	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
